name: What is the difference between a drop-in and a freestanding bathtub?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a drop-in and a freestanding bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference lies in their installation method and aesthetic. A drop-in bathtub is designed to be installed within a custom-built frame or deck, which is often tiled or finished with other materials. The rim of the tub is flush with the surrounding deck, giving a built-in appearance. In contrast, a freestanding bathtub stands on its own without being enclosed by walls or a deck. It typically has a finished exterior on all sides, creating a statement piece in the bathroom and offering more flexibility in placement. Freestanding tubs often require different plumbing arrangements as well.
acceptedAnswer.description: A drop-in tub is set into a custom deck, appearing built-in, while a freestanding tub stands alone with a finished exterior, acting as a focal point.
